title: Lesley H Possible NDE 7213
content: I ran to catch a bus with the destination 'hospital' written on the front. I was dropped off in a beautiful, sunlit field of long, waving grass. I remember the sun shone through the grass as I parted it with my hands. I felt an overwhelming sense of joy. I was running towards a house in the middle of the field. It was a dark brick house with many doorway arches. From every side of the house people were running through the grass towards it. We were all laughing and smiling at each other as we ran. I didn't recognize any of these people but I could feel a communal joy and happiness as if we were all sharing an amazing experience. When I arrived at one of the doorways, an official looking man asked me if I knew I had died. I felt surprised at first. Then I recognized that I had died but was not fearful. He asked me what I wanted to do and that's what I remember most significantly; that I actually had a choice; a concept I had never contemplated in everyday life. He told me if I wanted more life I could go back but if I wanted to pass over and go through the doorway I could and I knew that this would be joyous and eternal but I already knew it would also be there forever, whenever I decided to go. I felt immensely comforted with the knowledge that this afterlife would always be there so I decided to go back to the quirky little life on earth which I hadn't yet had enough of, safe in the knowledge this beautiful afterlife would always be there after death.

arrival.other_being_detail: An 'official looking man' at a doorway asked if she knew she had died and explained she could choose to go back or pass through the doorway.

environment.environment_other_detail: A beautiful, sunlit field of long waving grass with sunlight shining through it; a dark brick house with many doorway arches in the middle of the field.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She wanted more life and chose to go back to her 'quirky little life on earth' because she 'hadn't yet had enough of' it, comforted that the afterlife would be there later.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Arrival via a bus to a sunlit field; many unknown people running joyfully toward a house; an official-looking man at a doorway explained she had died and offered a choice to return or pass through.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light/life review described; experience centers on arriving in a pleasant realm, communal joy, a doorway threshold, and an explicit choice to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Arrival involved catching a bus with 'hospital' on the front and being dropped off in a sunlit field where many people ran laughing toward a dark brick house with doorway arches.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “an official looking man asked me if I knew I had died.” “He asked me what I wanted to do… that I actually had a choice” “if I wanted to pass over and go through the doorway… this would be joyous and eternal… it would also be there forever, whenever I decided to go.”
